name: Dhvija Finance Limited
about: Dhvija Finance Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company offers products, such as Personal Loans, Business Loans, and NCD Investments. The company also offers lending services, and accessible financial solutions to individuals, salaried professionals, micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), and businesses. The company was formerly known as F Mec International Financial Services Limited and changed its name to Dhvija Finance Limited in August 2026. F Mec International Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New Delhi, India.
